name: F-1 Academic Student
description: Non-immigrant visa for full-time academic study at an SEVP-certified institution.

name: F-2 Dependent of F-1
description: Dependent (spouse or unmarried child under 21) of an F-1 visa holder.

name: J-1 Exchange Visitor
description: Exchange visitor visa for approved cultural and educational exchange programs.

name: M-1 Vocational Student
description: Non-immigrant visa for vocational or non-academic study.

name: Student Visa
description: UK Student route visa for those aged 16 or over (formerly Tier 4 General).

name: Child Student Visa
description: UK Child Student route visa for ages 4-17 attending an independent school.

name: Student Dependant Visa
description: Visa for partners and children of UK Student route holders.

name: Subclass 500 Student Visa
description: Australian Student Visa for full-time study in a registered course.

name: Subclass 590 Student Guardian
description: Visa to accompany a student under 18 or those needing care while studying in Australia.

name: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate (PSW)
description: Post-Study Work visa for international students after completing eligible studies.

name: Study Permit
description: Permit to study at a Designated Learning Institution in Canada.

name: Post-Graduation Work Permit
description: Open work permit for graduates of eligible Canadian post-secondary programs.

name: International Experience Canada
description: Working holiday / young professional / international co-op visa under IEC.

name: Student Visa
description: New Zealand visa to study full-time at an approved institution.

name: Student Visa § 16a
description: German residence permit for studies at a state-recognised higher education institution.

name: Language Course / School Visa § 16b
description: German residence permit for language courses or school attendance.

name: Stamp 2 (Student)
description: Irish immigration permission for full-time study on the ILEP list.

name: Stamp 2A (Limited Study)
description: Irish immigration permission for non-ILEP / semester-abroad students; no work allowed.

name: Long-stay Student Visa (VLS-TS)
description: French long-stay visa equivalent to a residence permit for students.

name: MVV Student Residence Permit
description: Netherlands MVV / residence permit for full-time study at a recognised institution.

name: Student Visa (Ryugaku)
description: Japanese student status of residence for higher education and language schools.
